_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored because the webhook URL is a secret - anyone holding it can post to your channel as the bot. The same file contents also go into the DISCORD_CONFIG repo secret so GitHub Actions can post; see worker/ADMIN-SETUP.md. Strip these _comment keys or leave them - the tools ignore unknown keys.
_comment_leagues: Per-league webhook. The key must match the league slug.
_comment_roleMention: Optional. id = a role ID to ping at the top of each announcement. Set everyone to "true" to use @everyone instead. Leave both blank for no blanket ping.
_comment_coaches: Keys must match the `name` in league-data.js exactly (matching is case-insensitive). `id` is the numeric Discord user ID - Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-click a user > Copy ID. `username` is only a label to help you match rows; it is never used for pinging. A coach with no id still appears in the message as bold text instead of a ping, and advance.js warns by name on every run.
